name: todo
title: Todo
description: Ordered task queue for serializing batch work
author: Chris-Alexander-Pop

commands.name: todo
commands.title: Todo
commands.subtitle: Queue
commands.description: Add, reorder, and check off an ordered task queue with priorities and reminders

commands.name: remind
commands.title: Todo Reminders
commands.subtitle: Quiet
commands.description: Desktop notifications for due tasks. Background poll; run manually to ping immediately.

preferences.name: notificationsEnabled
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.label: Send desktop notifications for due tasks
preferences.description: When off, reminders are stored but never ping

preferences.name: bootGraceSeconds
preferences.title: Boot delay (seconds)
preferences.description: After Vicinae starts (or a long gap), wait this long before firing reminders that were already due

preferences.name: sessionGapMinutes
preferences.title: New session after (minutes)
preferences.description: If the reminder poller was quiet this long, treat the next poll as a new boot/session

preferences.name: nagMinutes
preferences.title: Re-notify every (minutes)
preferences.description: 0 = once per day (or once ever, for Once reminders). Otherwise ping again while still overdue

preferences.name: defaultReminderTime
preferences.title: Default reminder time
preferences.description: HH:MM (24-hour local) pre-filled on the add form
